title: Novel dual-targeted protein specifically binding to DLL4 and VEGF, and use thereof
abstract_text: The present invention relates to a dual-targeted protein comprising: a novel protein specifically binding to delta like ligand 4 (DLL4); and an antibody specifically binding to a vascular endothelial cell growth factor (VEGF).
claims_text: [CLAIMS] [Claim 1] A dual-targeting protein comprising: a protein specifically binding to DLL4, which recognizes a conformational epitope of DLL4 comprising amino acid residues 58th to 65th amino acid sequences and 110th to 115th amino acid sequences in amino acid sequences of DLL4 protein represented by SEQ ID NO:21, and an antibody specifically binding to VEGF(Vascular endothelial growth factor). [Claim 2] The dual-targeting protein of claim 1, wherein the protein specifically binding to DLL4 comprising: a heavy chain variable region comprising heavy chain CDR1 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:2, heavy chain CDR2 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:3, and heavy chain CDR3 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:4, and a light chain variable region comprising light chain CDR1 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:5, light chain CDR2 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:6, and light chain CDR3 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:7. [Claim 3] The dual-targeting protein of claim 1, wherein the double-targeting protein is a form in which the protein that binds specifically to DLL4 and the IgG (immunoglobulin G)-type antibody that binds specifically to VEGF are connected to each other by a linker. [Claim 4] The dual-targeting protein of claim 3, wherein the linker is a peptidyl linker or a non-peptide linker. [Claim 5] The dual-targeting protein of claim 4, wherein the peptide linker has an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 18. [Claim 6] The dual-targeting protein of claim 1, wherein the protein binding specifically to DLL4 comprise a heavy-chain amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 8 and a light-chain amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 9. [Claim 7] The dual-targeting protein of claim 1, wherein the antibody specifically binding to VEGF comprising: a heavy chain variable region comprising heavy chain CDR1 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 10, heavy chain CDR2 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 11, and heavy chain CDR3 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 12, and a light chain variable region comprising light chain CDR1 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 13, light chain CDR2 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 14, and light chain CDR3 having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 15. [Claim 8] The dual-targeting protein of claim 1, wherein the antibody specifically binding to VEGF comprising a heavy chain variable region having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 16 and a a light chain variable region having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 17. [Claim 9] The dual-targeting protein of claim 8, wherein the antibody binding specifically to VEGF is Bevacizumab. [Claim 10] The dual-targeting protein of claim 1, wherein the dual-targeting protein comprises a heavy chain variable region having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:l and a light chain variable region having an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO:20. [Claim 11] The dual-targeting protein of claim 1, wherein the protein binding specifically to DLL4 is in the form of full-length antibodies, Fab', F(ab')2, Fab, Fv, rlgG, or scFv(Single-chain variable fragment). [Claim 12] A polynucleotide encoding the dual-targeting protein of any one of claims 1 to 11. [Claim 13] An expression vector comprising the polynucleotide of claim 12. [Claim 14] A transformant introduced with the expression vector of claim 13. [Claim 15] A method for producing a dual-targeting protein comprising a protein that binds specifically to DFF4 and an antibody that binds specifically to VEGF (vascular endothelial growth factor), the method comprising the steps of: (a) culturing the transformant according to claim 14 to produce a dual-targeting protein; and (b) recovering the dual-targeting protein produced in step (a). [Claim 16] A composition comprising the dual-targeting protein of any one of claims 1 to 11. [Claim 17] A pharmaceutical composition for treating cancer, which comprises the dualtargeting protein of any one of claims 1 to 11. [Claim 18] The pharmaceutical composition of claim 17, wherein the cancer is selected from the group consisting of esophageal cancer, stomach cancer, large intestine cancer, rectal cancer, oral cancer, pharynx cancer, larynx cancer, lung cancer, colon cancer, breast cancer, uterine cervical cancer, endometrial cancer, ovarian cancer, prostate cancer, testis cancer, bladder cancer, renal cancer, liver cancer, pancreatic cancer, bone cancer, connective tissue cancer, skin cancer, brain cancer, thyroid cancer, leukemia, Hodgkin's disease, lymphoma, and multiple myeloid blood cancer. [Claim 19] A composition for diagnosing cancer, which comprises the dual-targeting protein of any one of claims 1 to 11. [Claim 20] A method for diagnosing cancer, comprising the steps of: (a) measuring the level of VEGF or DLL4 protein in a sample, isolated from a subject suspected of having cancer, using the dual-targeting protein of any one of claims 1 to 11; and (b) determining that the subject has cancer, if the level of VEGF or DLL4 protein measured in step (a) is higher than that in a normal control sample. [Claim 21] A conformational epitope of DLL4 comprising amino acid residues 58th to 65th and 110th to 115th in the amino acid sequence of a DLL4 (delta-like ligand 4) protein represented by SEQ ID NO: 21. [Claim 22] A monoclonal antibody binding specifically to DLL4, which recognizes the conformational epitope of claim 21. [Claim 23] A polynucleotide encoding the monoclonal antibody of claim 22. [Claim 24] An expression vector comprising the polynucleotide of claim 23. [Claim 25] A transformant introduced with the expression vector of claim 24. [Claim 26] A method for treating cancer, which comprises a step of administering the dualtargeting protein of any one of claims 1 to 11 to a subject suspected of having cancer.

title: Method for Purifying Biologically Active Peptide by Using Protein A Affinity Chromatography

title: Anti-B7-H3 antibody and use thereof
abstract_text: Provided is an anti-B7-H3 antibody specifically recognizing a B7-H3, which can be usefully as a cancer therapeutic agent, as having an inhibitory activity of an immune checkpoint which induces antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity and T cell activation inhibited by B7-H3. In addition, it can be usefully used for cancer targeting treatment including detection of various cancers expressing B7-H3 through specific binding to B7-H3, and drug delivery to specific cancer, etc.

title: Anti-B7-H4/Anti-4-1BB Bispecific Antibodies And Use Thereof
abstract_text: The present disclosure provides an anti-B7-H4/anti-4-1BB bispecific antibody capable to effectively block the T-cell inhibitory effect of B7-H4 on the surface of tumor cells, and simultaneously activate 4-1BB on T-cells. The bispecific antibody may have high binding affinity to both of a B7-H4 protein (e.g., a human, monkey and mouse B7-H4 protein) and a 4-1BB protein (e.g., a human, monkey and mouse 4-1BB protein). The present disclosure also provides an anti-B7-H4 antibody specifically binds to B7-H4 protein.
